title: refactor(Development/AbelianVarietyTheory/Proofs/InertiaEigenvalues): deduplicate height and Frobenius period lattice constructions
body:
Generalizes the Frobenius rationality, Frobenius stability, column rationality, unit-basis, and finite-height Breuil–Kisin lattice constructions from `Seed` to an arbitrary disc period matrix `W` satisfying the shared bounded-period, Frobenius, and Galois hypotheses, removing the six duplicated `WSeed` copies in `ExistsBreuilKisinFrameSemistablePeriodsStatement.lean`.

Declarations changed:
- Renamed and generalized `GlobalTheory.BSP.FrobRational.main` to `GlobalTheory.BSP.FrobRational.of_frob_eq_mul` in `CrystallineLatticeFrobeniusRationalColumns.lean`.
- Renamed and generalized `GlobalTheory.BSP.seed_span_frobenius_stable` to `GlobalTheory.BSP.span_frobenius_stable_of_frob_eq_mul` in `CrystallineLatticeDiscSpanFrobeniusStable.lean`.
- Renamed and generalized `GlobalTheory.BSP.HeightSprime.main` to `GlobalTheory.BSP.HeightSprime.of_bounded_periods`, generalized `GlobalTheory.BSP.rational_in_columns` and `GlobalTheory.BSP.height_Z_isUnit`, and extracted `GlobalTheory.BSP.HeightEx.exists_height_of_periods` (with `GlobalTheory.BSP.HeightEx.nonempty_height` delegating to it) in `NonemptyDiscPeriodAinfBasisDataOfIsPer.lean`.
- Removed `GlobalTheory.BKLim.wseed_Z_isUnit`, `GlobalTheory.BKLim.FrobRational.main`, `GlobalTheory.BKLim.WHeightSprime.main`, `GlobalTheory.BKLim.wseed_span_frobenius_stable`, `GlobalTheory.BKLim.rational_in_columns_wseed` (with its three private helpers), and `GlobalTheory.BKLim.WHeight.exists_height` from `ExistsBreuilKisinFrameSemistablePeriodsStatement.lean`, delegating `GlobalTheory.BKLim.exists_pre_of_wseed` to `GlobalTheory.BSP.HeightEx.exists_height_of_periods`.
